result.reason: The redline appropriately extends the conformity warranty to the 90-day fallback period and preserves a remedy by referencing Section 19.4, assuming that section provides repair, replacement, or refund. However, it does not include the required professional-and-workmanlike services warranty, a 30-day services warranty, compliance with laws, or no-malicious-code warranty. It therefore does not reach even the full fallback position, although the changes made are narrow and professionally drafted.
